title: Stasis & Spells Shop
description: A silhouetted figure in a dark blue coat and hat stands before the blue door of a brick building at dusk, reaching out to touch a glowing white butterfly. The shop sign reads 'Stasis & Spells' with an hourglass emblem, surrounded by hanging glass potion bottles, papers, and magical symbols on the walls.
prompt: A mysterious figure in a dark blue velvet coat and wide-brimmed hat stands before an old brick building at twilight, reaching toward a glowing white butterfly on the blue shop door. The storefront is labeled 'Stasis & Spells' with an hourglass and wings logo. Glass potion bottles hang from the awning, papers and magical symbols adorn the walls, creating an enchanting and mysterious atmosphere.
